resources.string: Rules are checked each poll cycle. A condition must hold for the rule\'s sustained window before the action runs, and each rule fires at most once per interval per miner. Muted miners are skipped, unsupported control actions are skipped with a reason, and every fire raises a watchdog notification.
Min interval between fires per miner (min)
Control actions (pause/resume/reboot) use the miner\'s verified control path and are skipped where unsupported. Plug actions need a configured smart plug. Test with a high interval first.
